pages.title: Hyperdimensional Processor
pages.text: The fourth tier of processor. Its logic gates take inputs from directions that do not exist in our space, folded into a chip I can hold. It computes faster than its visible wiring allows, and it is heavier than it looks.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Only the Femtoscale Assembly Line could place a Hyperdimensional Die, a Topological Processor and three attoscale components onto one board with enough precision. It worked the first time.
